 Rihanna’s son Riot Rose, 3, models Chanel and diamonds on first solo magazine cover 
 By 
 Melissa Minton 
 Published 
 Nov. 13, 2026, 12:30 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 9 
 Rihanna’s son Riot Rose wears Chanel on one of several Arena Homme+ magazine covers. thehommeplusmag/ instagram 
 Rihanna and A$AP Rocky are creating an army of fashion killas .
 The “Diamonds” singer is a fixture on the front of fashion glossies, but now she’s passing the torch to her middle child.
 Three-year-old Riot Rose recently landed his first-ever magazine cover — make that covers , plural — appearing solo in a fashion-filled pictorial for Arena Homme+.
 And the tiny tot is decked out in designer duds, including a $12,450 tweed Chanel jacket that showed on the house’s runway in April. Dad Rocky was in attendance at the collection’s debut, carrying a pair of tiny ballet flats ostensibly for daughter Rocki Irish. However, it appears the rapper was scouting styles for all of his children.
 9 
 Riot wears a glittering diamond and ruby necklace in one shot. thehommeplusmag/ instagram

 And he’s joined by his mom — in a symbolic red jumpsuit — for another pic. thehommeplusmag/ instagram 
 On another cover, Riot — who was styled by Rih’s go-to stylist, Jahleel Weaver — strikes a pose in a dazzling diamond and ruby collar from Chopard.
 He’s joined by his glamorous mom in another shot, with the Bal Gal sporting the same necklace along with the red one-piece Loewe jumpsuit she wore to perform in the Super Bowl 2023 halftime show .
 Rihanna memorably revealed she was pregnant with Riot during her set.
 9 
 Riot looked dapper in his first solo cover shoot. thehommeplusmag/ instagram 
 9 
 He posed on a Louis Vuitton silver trunk in a head-to-toe LV look. thehommeplusmag/ instagram 
 9 
 Riot, 3, is Rihanna’s youngest son and middle child. thehommeplusmag/ instagram 
 Elsewhere in the shoot, Riot looks dapper in a pinstriped overcoat bedecked with brooches and topped with a newsboy cap.
 Fashion fanatics praised the images in proud mom Rihanna’s Instagram comments. “Oh he’s made for this! The mug is serious lol🔥🔥🔥,” said one while another wrote, “STOOOOP!! The little fashion KILLA!! Hes gonna put you out of a job rih 🤣🤣🤣.”
 While it may be Riot’s breakout moment, the family of five is no stranger to a major magazine moment.
 Rihanna, Rocky and older brother RZA graced the cover of British Vogue in February 2023, when the pop icon was pregnant with Riot.
 9 
 He previously wore fresh-off-the-runway Dior with brother RZA and mom Rihanna at the “Smurfs” premiere in July 2025. FilmMagic 
 9 
 RZA and Riot also starred in a Savage X Fenty 2024 ad campaign. Instagram/@badgalriri 
 9 
 Rihanna and Riot supported A$AP Rocky at his AWGE show during Paris Fashion Week last year. Getty Images 
 The boys have both appeared in fashion campaigns not only for mom’s Savage X Fenty line , but also alongside their dad in a sweet Bottega Veneta Father’s Day ad .
 And baby Rocki became a magazine cover star earlier this year, when she was just six months old — wearing a Dior Haute Couture diaper and floral headpiece, of course.
 We can only imagine what the Mayers’ Christmas cards might look like.
